questions.prompt: Which component loses its contents when the computer is turned off?
questions.explanation:
B. RAM

RAM is temporary working memory and does not keep its contents without power.

questions.prompt: What is the CPU’s main job?
options: B. Run program instructions and perform calculations
questions.answer: B. Run program instructions and perform calculations
questions.explanation:
B. Run program instructions and perform calculations

The CPU processes instructions and calculations for the computer.

questions.prompt: What do SSDs and HDDs both do?
options: A. Keep files when the computer is off
questions.answer: A. Keep files when the computer is off
questions.explanation:
A. Keep files when the computer is off

Both are storage devices that keep data without power.

questions.prompt: What is a sensible first check if a computer overheats?
options: A. Safely check that air vents are not blocked
C. Pour water on a fan
questions.answer: A. Safely check that air vents are not blocked
questions.explanation:
A. Safely check that air vents are not blocked

Blocked airflow can cause heat; opening electrical components is dangerous.
